name: First and last frame (LTX)
description: Makes an LTX-2 video that starts at one frame and ends at another, as ComfyUI's LTX-2.3 first-last-frame template does: each frame is fitted to the workflow's size, prepared and added as a guide (LTXVAddGuide at the first and the last frame), and the guide frames are cropped off after sampling (LTXVCropGuides). Core nodes only.
